title: 宝塚記念の後に・届いた指先

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature receives praise from Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan after giving it her all to win the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature is inspired by how their motivation for the next race remains unfazed by defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that she can now run well in a bigger race, I suggest that she run in the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mustering up the strength to keep herself from falling back to her reluctant ways, Nice Nature makes up her mind to tackle the big race.
